words.gloss: to those who have attained clarity

literal: From doubt having freed themselves, to those who have attained clarity, than the earth, heaven nearer it has.
translation: To those who have freed themselves from doubt and attained clear vision, heaven is closer than this earth.
modern: ஐயத்திலிருந்து நீங்கி மெய்ப்பொருளைத் தெளிவாக உணர்ந்தவர்களுக்கு, இவ்வுலகத்தை விட வானுலகம் மிக அருகில் உள்ளதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the state of those who have attained true knowledge. When a person removes all doubts (ஐயம்) and achieves absolute clarity of mind (தெளிவு), the ultimate state of liberation (வானம்) is closer to them than this physical earth (வையம்) they inhabit. The poet uses the word 'நணியது' (nearer) to emphasize that liberation is not a distant, unreachable goal but an immediate reality for the enlightened mind.
